Class Repositories

java.lang.Object
repositories.Repositories
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Repositories extends Object implements Serializable
The Repositories class acts as a centralized container for various repository instances used in the application. Each repository serves a specific purpose and provides methods for managing corresponding types of data. This class follows the Singleton design pattern to ensure that only one instance of the Repositories class is created during the application's lifecycle.
